dynamicContent: Source and Native both use ec_<validated slug>; retain identical names, locale/field/content bytes and Source index names. No invented prefix mapping.

requiredTransforms.rule: Map only recognized physical table names; preserve caller aliases, schema-qualified unrelated names and column identifiers. SourceDatabase remains the complete pinned type; no unknown-as-success casts.

Use a SQL token/context-aware transform for actual table/reference targets. Preserve string literals, comments, field names, aliases, trigger names and values. Blind global mapping of media/options tokens is insufficient.

Map Source table names only in recognized tableExists/columnExists/listTableColumns catalog positions: sqlite_master name equality and pragma_table_info table argument. Ordinary persisted values equal to Source identifiers remain byte exact. Source ec_% patterns/results remain unchanged.

Source original recorders and SeedBudget must observe every complete logical query before native mapping, including atomic-batch statements and db.withPlugin-derived instances. Zero logical field-read counts after early mapping give no credit. Adapter/executor identities and request-cache context must persist.

Keep existing canonicalSourceDatabase D1 write boundary unchanged for existing callers. A seed-specific mutation adapter requires whole finite statement plans via real CmsDatabase.atomicBatch and ≤100 parameters per statement. No callback fallback or disabled boundary.

Use actual persisted expanded/active state and one live provider/error-class identity. Active creation must prepare identity/fingerprint, create table, install+verify3triggers, mark ready, publish metadata/indexes, finalize in Source order. No fabricated inactive row or ready success.
